observations.claim: The annual State of Dutch Tech 2026 measures 2025, so it must not be presented as 2026 actuals.
The 2025 report records €2.64 billion venture capital. Its summary reports fewer deals and more capital going to larger rounds; early-stage funding pressure is therefore a useful discovery priority.
observations.qualification: The prioritisation is researcher inference from report findings, not a measured Atlas coverage result.

observations.claim: Deep tech accounted for 41% of venture capital and 41% of scaleups in that report.
Research spin-offs and specialised physical infrastructure justify separate geographic queues rather than an Amsterdam-only search.
observations.qualification: Research design inference; not a claim that these sources enumerate all Dutch companies.
